source.note: End-to-end SSE streaming TTS round trip. The events array below is the UPSTREAM provider SSE stream, transcribed verbatim from the Go test's events literal (L335-340); the final frame is the '[DONE]' sentinel. Client-side expectations asserted by the Go test: outbound request carries Accept 'text/event-stream' and passes stream_format 'sse' through the wire body; the client stream forwards exactly 3 events (delta, delta, done) with the '[DONE]' sentinel swallowed by the inbound transformer; the terminal event carries SSE Type 'speech.audio.done'; collected[0] contains '"speech.audio.delta"' and collected[2] contains '"speech.audio.done"'. The exact byte payload of each forwarded client frame is not byte-asserted by the Go test (contains-only) — the client-side per-frame stream is pending source snapshot. Aggregation: inbound.AggregateStreamChunks over the same 4 upstream events must yield a body containing '"audio_bytes":8' (base64 'YWJjZA=='+'ZWZnaA==' decode to 4+4 bytes), meta.Completed==true, meta.Usage.TotalTokens==12; the full aggregate body shape {object:'audio.speech.stream', audio_bytes:8, chunks:4} follows aggregateSpeechStreamChunks (audio_inbound.go L426-441) with llm.SpeechStreamResponseID=='audio.speech.stream' (llm/audio.go L7), of which only audio_bytes is byte-asserted.

inbound_http._comment: clientBody = json.Marshal(map{model:'gpt-4o-mini-tts', input:'Hi', voice:'alloy', stream_format:'sse'}) with Content-Type application/json (L313-321).
